comment: Snapshot extraction: GET /api/snapshot, its throttle (getSnapshotThrottled) and the two Maps behind it move from server.js to routes/snapshot.js. Executed only with the owner's OK to Dev, mechanically by tools/refactor/codemods/extract-snapshot.js (one contiguous slice; the declared rewrites CFG -> getConfig() and PRINTERS -> getPrinters(), one occurrence each).
sourceRange: One contiguous slice of server.js at the base: lines 4293-4344 (52 lines). 4293-4304: the comment block "// Server-side throttle for the fleet Camera View's automatic polling…"; 4305 snapshotCache; 4306 snapshotInflight; 4307-4324 getSnapshotThrottled; 4325 blank; 4326-4344 app.get("/api/snapshot"). STAYS in server.js, unchanged: the "// ---- Camera snapshot" comment, getSnapshot (4280) and checkSnapshot (4285) above the slice — also used by notifications (server.js 6876 and 7175 at the base) — the blank line 4292, and everything from the blank line 4345 on (the "// ---- Live camera" comment, GET /api/camera-stream, GET /api/thumbnail). Nothing outside 4293-4344 mentions snapshotCache, snapshotInflight or getSnapshotThrottled (checked by the codemod).

injected.getSnapshot: server.js:4280 async function (stays in server.js with checkSnapshot; declared above the registration)
injected.how: parameters of registerSnapshotRoutes(app, { requireAuth, getConfig, getPrinters, printerVisibleTo, getSnapshot }). getSnapshotThrottled and the route use injected names, so both are declared inside registerSnapshotRoutes (indented by two, text otherwise unchanged apart from the two rewrites); the comment block and the two Maps stay at module scope with their text unchanged. No module-level dependency slots. The moved code's free names at the base are exactly CFG, PRINTERS, app, requireAuth, printerVisibleTo, getSnapshot and the language globals Map, Date, parseInt (checked by the codemod); the finished module's are Map, Date, parseInt and module.

exports: module.exports = { registerSnapshotRoutes } — nothing else, no _internal: every pin goes through the route. registerSnapshotRoutes returns nothing (test/helpers/snapshotCode.js refuses a return value and any other export).
strictMode: routes/snapshot.js has no "use strict" (server.js is sloppy mode; semantics kept identical).

moduleState.snapshotCache: module scope of routes/snapshot.js; created once when server.js requires the module at the original position (same point in start-up as before: after getSnapshot/checkSnapshot are defined, before GET /api/camera-stream registers); process lifetime; never reset by a config reload; emptied only by a restart. Keyed by printer INDEX, as before (pinned, not changed).
moduleState.registration: server.js requires the module and calls registerSnapshotRoutes(app, {...}) at the moved code's original position (replacing lines 4293-4344), so the Express handler order is unchanged (… fleet …, snapshot, camera-stream, thumbnail …). getSnapshotThrottled becomes a function declared inside registerSnapshotRoutes instead of a hoisted top-level function of server.js; nothing outside the moved block referenced it (checked by the codemod), so this is unobservable — stated for the Guardian.

declaredHarnessNotes.test/snapshotCheck.test.js: line 16 only: the source text is server.js followed by routes/snapshot.js with the register function's two-space indentation removed. Why de-indented rather than changing the route's end marker on line 50 to "\n  });": extractFn() (lines 17-22) cuts a function at the first "\n}" — for the indented getSnapshotThrottled that would run on to the end of registerSnapshotRoutes and take the route with it, so the assertion on line 54 (getSnapshotThrottled itself awaits getSnapshot(p)) could be satisfied by the route's text. De-indented, extractFn("getSnapshotThrottled") and the route slice on line 50 are the same texts as at the base (apart from PRINTERS -> getPrinters() inside the route), and lines 17-55 stay byte-identical. extractFn("getSnapshot") / ("checkSnapshot") still find server.js's own functions first (server.js comes first; the module declares neither). The message "must exist in server.js" on line 20 is an assertion line and is deliberately left as it is.
declaredHarnessNotes.test/connectors/creality-webrtc-camera.t: line 19 only: routes/snapshot.js joins the scanned source after server.js, so line 178 (app.get("/api/snapshot" is still in place) keeps passing for the route's new home. Every other use of serverSrc in the file (lines 22-23, 141-143, 158-160, 179, 185, 403, 407, 412, 420) is an indexOf / first match / fixed-length slice that resolves inside server.js's own text exactly as before (the latest of them starts at offset 319335 of 452001 at the base and takes at most 2200 characters), or a count of a pattern the module does not contain (...webrtcCameraFields(p, conn): 2). The file has no doesNotMatch on serverSrc itself.
declaredHarnessNotes.test/helpers/snapshotCode.js: declared helper (Guardian reviews every line): only the header comment, the SERVER->MODULE constant, the unused routeEnd import and loadSource() change. Base: slices server.js into the sandbox, where app/requireAuth/printerVisibleTo/getSnapshot/CFG/PRINTERS are globals; a reload is an assignment to the sandbox's CFG / PRINTERS. Head: runs routes/snapshot.js in the sandbox with a require() that refuses everything, removes those six globals, calls registerSnapshotRoutes(app, deps) with getConfig/getPrinters reading a holder that a reload reassigns, requires it to return nothing and the module to export registerSnapshotRoutes only. test/snapshotBehaviour.test.js is not changed.

contractNotes: snapshot.json: 26 requests, each with a declared status, plus one reload and one restart. LIMITATION: the harness fixture's three printers are klipper-moonraker, which has no getCameraSnapshot, so only 401 / 400 / 502 are reachable over real HTTP; the 200 answer, its headers, the cache, the shared in-flight fetch and fresh's re-priming are pinned in-process only (test/snapshotBehaviour.test.js). health.json and smoke.json unchanged. Nothing new is declared volatile.
packaging: Dockerfile already has `COPY routes ./routes` (added for Health); pkg follows the require graph (no pkg.scripts entry: not a worker); test/docker.test.js walks server.js's require graph and will see routes/snapshot.js under the existing COPY. No package.json or Dockerfile change. Policy rule 8: real Docker + pkg builds (V12) remain mandatory before deployment, each download/build owner-approved.

reconciliation.note: line numbers at the base. serverLines counts a trailing empty element (7,511 lines of text before, 7,466 after: 52 lines out, 7 lines of comment + require + registration in). rewriteOccurrences counts code only: CFG once in getSnapshotThrottled (the TTL), PRINTERS once in the route; the moved comment block's "CFG.cameraViewRefreshInterval" is a comment and stays as written.

verifiedBaseline.what: Baseline commit: application code identical to e5cbe42 (the Discover extraction); adds the pins (34), their loader and the snapshot contract set. Baseline evidence gathered by the Executor on this commit: pins 34/34; every declared mutation detected on base; every declared mutation detected by the same pins on the transiently applied extraction; snapshot and snapshot+health+smoke contract runs twice each with no errors and identical results, and one run of the transiently applied extraction identical to both (container runs made with a harness image derived offline from an existing local one, because the image for a context that includes requests/snapshot.json had not been built — the verifier builds its own).

extractionParent: Two different commits, not to be confused. (1) Verification baseline: the baseline commit named in `base` — the application and test files every result is measured against. (2) The extraction commit's immediate parent: the tooling-only commit that adds this manifest and the codemod. That commit changes nothing outside tools/refactor/, so its application and test files are identical to the verification baseline; the verifier's --base for re-runs may be either.

rollback.beforeCommit: the extraction is uncommitted: `git checkout -- server.js test/snapshotCheck.test.js test/connectors/creality-webrtc-camera.test.js test/helpers/snapshotCode.js && rm routes/snapshot.js` restores the application and tests exactly and leaves the tooling preparation in place
rollback.afterCommit: `git revert <extraction commit>` (keeps history), or `git reset --keep <the extraction commit's immediate parent>` = the tooling-only commit. Both keep the tooling (manifest, codemod, baseline pins and contract set).
rollback.notThis: `git reset --keep e5cbe42` would also drop the baseline and tooling commits — use it only if the preparation itself is to be withdrawn.
rollback.never: production main is not touched by any of this; it changes only through a separate release decision

knownToolingLimitations: the 200 answer cannot be reached in the container harness (no fixture printer has a camera): the frame, Content-Type, Cache-Control: no-store, the cache, the shared in-flight fetch and fresh's re-priming are pinned in-process only, against a fake res — what Express itself adds to a Buffer answer (Content-Length, ETag) is not pinned anywhere
the pins drive the route with fakes for app, requireAuth, printerVisibleTo, getSnapshot and the clock; getSnapshot and checkSnapshot do not move and keep their own tests (test/snapshotCheck.test.js)
concurrency is pinned in-process only (the harness client sends one request at a time)

public/app.js has two comments that say "see getSnapshotThrottled() in server.js" (lines 1399 and 14547 at the base); public/ is outside what a refactor may change, so they will name the old file until a separate change
